purpose: Turnout source handoff packages for Civic Result Maps native ETL.
notes: Packages point to official source artifacts already stored in this repository.
Generated turnout-data.js/json files are listed only as reference outputs; native ETL should parse the normalized CSV artifacts or the official raw artifacts directly.
Wisconsin is currently partial. Do not present this package as statewide turnout coverage.

states.name: Wisconsin
states.authority: Wisconsin county and municipal election offices; Wisconsin Elections Commission ward results provide result/review rows but not turnout denominators

existingNativeData.resultsReviewSource: data/Ward by Ward Report Federal and State Contests.xlsx

referenceTurnoutOutput.warningRule: Warn when registration denominator timing is preElectionDay or unknown.

normalizedArtifacts.rawArtifact: data/City of Milwaukee 2024 General Election Ward by Ward Results.pdf
normalizedArtifacts.caveat: Registered voter counts are treated as pre-Election-Day unless a final denominator source is found.
County-level turnout total only; not ward-level denominator data.
Registered-voter denominator timing is not stated, so rows must be warning-gated.
Registered-voter row is explicitly dated 11/01/2024, before Election Day, so rows must be warning-gated.

parserContract.joinStrategy: Use county + municipality + ward for ward-level rows when matching WEC ward result rows. Use county-only for Dane because the current source is county-level.

caveats: This is not a statewide Wisconsin turnout package.
Statewide WEC ward-by-ward results do not include registered-voter denominator fields.
Wisconsin same-day registration means pre-Election-Day denominators can understate final eligible/registered voters and may produce inflated turnout percentages.
Absentee, provisional, and reporting-unit handling can vary by local source.
Ward labels require normalization before joining to WEC ward result rows.
Additional county or municipal official canvass reports are needed for statewide native turnout coverage.
